Multiple Indian institutions announce admission and exam schedules

Several Indian educational institutions and police departments have released schedules for admissions, examinations, and recruitment processes. These announcements include dates for postgraduate admissions at Delhi University, entrance exams for IIT Kanpur, and recruitment processes for SBI Apprentices and UP Police Sub-Inspectors. The schedules are crucial for thousands of applicants seeking to secure seats or jobs.
